name: WF-366 — Revised Offer → Seller Offer Package & Dispatch Controller

parameters.jsCode: const i=$input.first().json||{};const now=new Date().toISOString();const dealId=i.deal_id||i.dealId;const leadId=i.lead_id||i.leadId;const propertyId=i.property_id||i.propertyId;const outcome=String(i.outcome||'').toLowerCase();const offer=Number(i.revised_offer||i.offer_amount||0);const mao=Number(i.adjusted_mao||i.dynamic_mao||0);const phone=String(i.seller_phone||i.phone||'').trim();const email=String(i.seller_email||i.email||'').trim();const dnc=Boolean(i.dnc||i.do_not_contact);const blockers=Array.isArray(i.blockers)?i.blockers:[];let route='human_control',reason='review_required',channel='';if(dnc){route='human_control';reason='dnc';}else if(blockers.length){route='human_control';reason='deal_blocker';}else if(!dealId||!leadId||!propertyId){route='reconciliation';reason='missing_identity';}else if(!['revised_offer','accept_or_contract'].includes(outcome)){route=outcome==='reengage'?'reengagement':'human_control';reason='offer_not_dispatchable';}else if(offer<=0||mao<=0||offer>mao){route='human_control';reason='offer_exceeds_mao_or_missing_amount';}else if(phone){channel='sms';route='dispatch';reason='sms_available';}else if(email){channel='email';route='dispatch';reason='email_fallback';}else{route='human_control';reason='missing_seller_contact';}const message=i.offer_message||'Hi, I wanted to follow up on the property. Based on our review, we can offer $'+offer.toFixed(2)+'. If that works for you, we can move forward with the next steps. Let me know what you think.';const key=(i.decision_idempotency_key||[dealId,leadId,propertyId,offer].join(':'))+':offer-dispatch';return[{json:{...i,workflow_id:'WF-366',status:'package_ready',route,reason,deal_id:dealId,lead_id:leadId,property_id:propertyId,offer_amount:offer,adjusted_mao:mao,channel,recipient:channel==='sms'?phone:email,message,offer_package:{offer_amount:offer,mao_protected:true,channel,recipient:channel==='sms'?phone:email,message},dispatch_idempotency_key:key,processed_at:now,crm_activity:{type:'seller_offer_package_dispatch',workflow_id:'WF-366',route,reason,offer_amount:offer,channel}}}];
